reviews.title: Not actually free
reviews.text: Not actually free. Need to pay a prescription to do anything

reviews.title: Helpful
reviews.text: Very good app. Could use a few more features (task and habit tracking) and rewards. Really like the interface

reviews.title: App doesn’t block anything
reviews.text: I have downloaded this app and have clicked the refresh button many times, I even chose the apps I need blocked and it still doesn’t block them I just have free access to them. Unless I’m missing something, this seems to be a waste of money. It doesn’t update to 100% for the productivity score every day just stays at the same % for days on end. It’s annoying.

reviews.title: life changing, finally stopped doomscrolling
reviews.text: before i found this app, my screen time was almost 11-12 hours a day. I was unable to get my work done because I was addicted to my phone. I tried everything to get over it but this app is the only solution that has actually stuck with my routine. I’d recommend to anyone also trying to reduce screentime!

reviews.title: So helpful
reviews.text: This app is actually so helpful & makes focusing on things that matter a lot easier. I have been spending significantly less time on social media, I highly recommend this app!

reviews.title: Good app. Terrible with accruing points
reviews.text: Downloaded the app am highly satisfied but was motivated to use focus times to increase my coinage to improve my avatar and sadly I’ve completed numerous focus times in my coins have not been accounted for try deleting the app restarting my phone trying different methods, but the coin method is a gimmick

reviews.title: Cool Concept
reviews.text: I like that the app holds you accountable for trying to open distracting apps and the focus sessions are a good idea. However, the price is kind of high imo and Clema has blocked apps I did not choose and I have to ‘take a break’ if I want to play Spotify in the background.

reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.text: As a med student, I can’t recommend this app enough. Not only is scrolling social media a huge waste of time, it’s also destroying our attention spans and ability to concentrate. The fact that you have to reflect before scrolling makes a huge difference!

reviews.title: Great app
reviews.text: Since downloading Clema, I’ve spent a lot less time on social media and a lot more time learning new things to help advance my career. I’d highly recommend it to both students and professionals.

reviews.title: actually works
reviews.text: i’ve been using this for a couple of months and my screen time dropped way more than i expected. i’ve been getting more done without even trying and the cute skins make it fun so i actually stick with it

reviews.title: Paid
reviews.text: You have to pay to do anything on the app

reviews.title: Didn’t even start
reviews.text: I was really looking forward to using this app because it looks great and I really need help with my phone addiction, but I can’t justify paying that much per month. Wish it was a more realistic price

reviews.title: Ugh
reviews.text: Such a great idea if it weren’t for the paywall :(

reviews.title: SaaS subscription slop
reviews.text: Asks for a review and rating before you even do anything and then paywalled.   The joke writes itself.

reviews.title: Helped me get my time back
reviews.text: Clema, is a unique experience that really adds a necessary step for screen time apps. Beyond just pressing a button to extend screen time, it taps into your awareness to make you realize the trade off, which is a powerful tool for screen time regulation.
